name: Pipe dream
description: Glossy 3D pipes trace an open book in isometric view: a red pipe round the left page, a blue pipe round the right, a yellow gutter pipe between them and shiny ball joints at every corner, with the screensaver’s black space inside the pages and thinner pipes for the lines of text.
choices: Pipes run only along the three axes and turn at ball joints, which is exactly what an isometric open book needs
No tangle of pipes: one book-shaped run, with the black space kept inside the pages
typography: DejaVu Sans Bold, plain outlined wordmark
